sentences.english: I always eat breakfast at seven.
sentences.chinese: 我总是七点吃早饭。

sentences.english: I didn't eat breakfast this morning, so now I'm really hungry.
sentences.chinese: 今天早上我没吃早饭，所以现在好饿。
sentences.scene: 上午感到饥饿时解释原因

sentences.english: On weekends, we eat breakfast together as a family and talk about our plans for the day.
sentences.chinese: 周末我们会全家一起吃早饭，聊聊当天的计划。

sentences.english: I have English class at nine.
sentences.chinese: 我九点有英语课。

sentences.english: Do you have math class today? I forgot my textbook.
sentences.chinese: 你今天有数学课吗？我忘带课本了。

sentences.english: I love it when we have art class because the teacher lets us use watercolors and paint whatever we want.
sentences.chinese: 我很喜欢上美术课，因为老师会让我们用水彩画任何想画的东西。

sentences.english: Let's play sports after school.
sentences.chinese: 放学后我们去运动吧。

sentences.english: My doctor said I should play sports at least three times a week.
sentences.chinese: 医生说我应该每周至少运动三次。

sentences.english: Even when I'm tired, playing sports always gives me more energy and clears my mind.
sentences.chinese: 即便很累，做运动也总能让我恢复精力，头脑清醒。
sentences.scene: 分享运动带来的积极感受

sentences.english: I need more exercise.
sentences.chinese: 我需要多锻炼。

sentences.english: Walking the dog every morning is good exercise for both of us.
sentences.chinese: 每天早上遛狗对我们俩都是很好的锻炼。

sentences.english: I used to hate exercise, but now I look forward to my morning run because it's the only time I get to listen to my favorite podcasts.
sentences.chinese: 我以前讨厌锻炼，但现在很期待晨跑，因为那是我唯一能听喜欢播客的时间。

sentences.english: We do morning exercises at school.
sentences.chinese: 我们在学校做早操。

sentences.english: My grandpa still does morning exercises in the park every day.
sentences.chinese: 我爷爷每天还在公园做早操。

sentences.english: At first, I found it embarrassing to do morning exercises with the group, but now I don't care and actually enjoy it.
sentences.chinese: 起初我觉得跟着一群人在公园做早操很尴尬，但现在我不在意了，还乐在其中。
sentences.scene: 克服害羞融入集体锻炼

sentences.english: Let's eat dinner together tonight.
sentences.chinese: 今晚我们一起吃晚饭吧。

sentences.english: We usually eat dinner around seven when my dad gets home.
sentences.chinese: 我们通常在爸爸到家后七点左右吃晚饭。

sentences.english: I was so busy studying that I forgot to eat dinner, and now the cafeteria is already closed.
sentences.chinese: 我学习太投入忘了吃晚饭，现在食堂已经关门了。

sentences.english: I have to clean my room today.
sentences.chinese: 我今天得打扫房间。

sentences.english: My mom said I can't go out until I clean my room.
sentences.chinese: 妈妈说我不打扫完房间就不能出去。
sentences.scene: 被要求先做家务才能出门

sentences.english: I always put on loud music when I clean my room, and somehow it turns a boring chore into a fun dance session.
sentences.chinese: 我每次打扫房间都会放很大声的音乐，不知怎的就把无聊的家务变成了有趣的跳舞时间。

sentences.english: Let's go for a walk after dinner.
sentences.chinese: 晚饭后我们去散步吧。

sentences.english: I usually go for a walk in the park to clear my head.
sentences.chinese: 我常常去公园散步，让头脑清醒一下。

sentences.english: When I feel stressed, I just go for a walk around the neighborhood without my phone, and it helps me think more clearly.
sentences.chinese: 感到压力大时，我就不带手机在小区走走，这样能让我思考更清晰。

sentences.english: I need to go shopping for groceries.
sentences.chinese: 我需要去买点菜。

sentences.english: Do you want to go shopping with me this weekend? There's a big sale.
sentences.chinese: 周末你想和我一起去逛街吗？有大减价。

sentences.english: I hate going shopping on Saturdays because the mall is always so crowded that you can barely walk.
sentences.chinese: 我讨厌周六去购物，因为商场总是挤得走不动路。

sentences.english: Take an umbrella with you.
sentences.chinese: 带把伞。

sentences.english: Don't forget to take your keys before you leave the house.
sentences.chinese: 出门前别忘了带钥匙。

sentences.english: It takes about 20 minutes to walk to school, but only 5 minutes if I ride my bike.
sentences.chinese: 走去学校要花20分钟，但如果骑自行车只需要5分钟。

sentences.english: I love dancing to pop music.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢跟着流行音乐跳舞。

sentences.english: She's been taking dancing lessons since she was five.
sentences.chinese: 她从五岁起就在上舞蹈课了。

sentences.english: Dancing always puts me in a good mood, even if I'm just doing silly moves in the kitchen.
sentences.chinese: 跳舞总能让我的心情变好，即使只是随便在厨房里跳些傻傻的动作。

sentences.english: I want to take a dancing class.
sentences.chinese: 我想去上舞蹈课。

sentences.english: My sister and I take a dancing class together every Tuesday evening.
sentences.chinese: 我和妹妹每周二晚上一起去上舞蹈课。

sentences.english: Even though I have two left feet, I decided to take a dancing class, and the teacher is so patient that I'm actually improving.
sentences.chinese: 虽然我笨手笨脚，但我还是决定去上舞蹈课，老师特别耐心，我竟然真的在进步。
sentences.scene: 挑战不擅长的事并获得进步

sentences.english: When is your birthday?
sentences.chinese: 你的生日是什么时候？

sentences.english: I was about to call you when my phone battery died.
sentences.chinese: 我正要给你打电话，结果手机没电了。

sentences.english: When I was a kid, I believed that the moon followed our car everywhere we drove at night.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候一直以为，晚上我们开车去哪里，月亮就会跟到哪里。

sentences.english: We can play after lunch.
sentences.chinese: 午饭后我们可以去玩。

sentences.english: After the movie, we went for ice cream and talked about the ending.
sentences.chinese: 看完电影后，我们去吃了冰淇淋，还讨论了结局。

sentences.english: After I finished all my homework, I rewarded myself with an episode of my favorite show.
sentences.chinese: 做完所有作业后，我奖励自己看了一集最喜欢的剧。

sentences.english: The movie starts at eight.
sentences.chinese: 电影八点开始。

sentences.english: I need to start my homework soon, or I'll be up all night.
sentences.chinese: 我得尽快开始做作业了，不然得熬夜了。

sentences.english: Once you start learning to play an instrument, it's hard to stop because you see progress every day.
sentences.chinese: 一旦你开始学一门乐器，就很难停下来，因为每天都能看到进步。

sentences.english: I usually walk to school.
sentences.chinese: 我通常走路上学。

sentences.english: She usually brings her lunch from home, but today she's eating out.
sentences.chinese: 她通常从家带午饭，但今天在外面吃。

sentences.english: I usually don't drink coffee after 3 p.m., because it keeps me awake at night.
sentences.chinese: 我通常下午三点后不喝咖啡，因为那会让我晚上睡不着。

sentences.english: I want to visit Spain someday.
sentences.chinese: 我想有朝一日去西班牙旅游。

sentences.english: My cousin studied abroad in Spain and loved the food there.
sentences.chinese: 我表姐在西班牙留学过，非常喜欢那里的食物。

sentences.english: When we were in Spain, we got lost in the narrow streets of Seville and stumbled upon the most amazing tapas bar.
sentences.chinese: 在西班牙时，我们在塞维利亚狭窄的街道里迷了路，却意外发现了一家超棒的塔帕斯酒吧。

sentences.english: Sorry, I'm late.
sentences.chinese: 抱歉，我迟到了。

sentences.english: I stayed up too late watching TV and now I'm exhausted.
sentences.chinese: 我看电视睡得太晚，现在困死了。

sentences.english: I was late for the meeting because the bus broke down, and I had to walk the last mile in the rain.
sentences.chinese: 我开会迟到了，因为公交车坏了，最后只能冒雨走完最后一英里。

sentences.english: The class starts at 9 a.m.
sentences.chinese: 课上午九点开始。

sentences.english: I have to wake up at 5 a.m. to catch the early flight.
sentences.chinese: 我得早上五点起床赶早班飞机。

sentences.english: Nothing good ever happens at 3 a.m.; that's when you should be fast asleep and saving your energy for the next day.
sentences.chinese: 凌晨三点没什么好事，那应该是你熟睡为第二天积蓄精力的时候。

sentences.english: See you at 2 p.m. today.
sentences.chinese: 今天下午两点见。

sentences.english: The museum closes at 5 p.m., so we should hurry.
sentences.chinese: 博物馆下午五点关门，我们得抓紧了。

sentences.english: I'm not a morning person at all; my brain doesn't start working properly until after 10 p.m.
sentences.chinese: 我完全不是早起型人，我的大脑直到晚上十点以后才能正常运转。

sentences.english: Why are you so sad?
sentences.chinese: 你为什么这么难过？

sentences.english: I don't understand why the bus is always late on Mondays.
sentences.chinese: 我不明白为什么周一的公交车总是晚点。

sentences.english: My little sister is at that age where she asks 'why' about everything, and sometimes I just don't have an answer.
sentences.chinese: 我妹妹正处在什么都问为什么的年纪，有时我实在答不上来。

sentences.english: The shop opens at 10 a.m.
sentences.chinese: 商店上午十点开门。

sentences.english: I need to shop for a birthday present for my mom.
sentences.chinese: 我需要去给我妈买生日礼物。

sentences.english: I found a little antique shop hidden down a side street, and I spent an hour just browsing through all the old treasures.
sentences.chinese: 我在一条小巷子里发现了一家隐藏的古董店，光浏览那些老物件就花了一小时。

sentences.english: I have to work late tonight.
sentences.chinese: 我今晚得加班。

sentences.english: My new phone doesn't work properly; the screen keeps freezing.
sentences.chinese: 我的新手机不太好用，屏幕总是卡住。

sentences.english: It took a lot of work to fix up the old house, but now that we're finally finished, it feels amazing.
sentences.chinese: 翻修老房子费了好大功夫，但现在终于弄完了，感觉太棒了。

sentences.english: That was the last cookie.
sentences.chinese: 那是最后一块饼干了。

sentences.english: I saw a great movie last weekend; you should watch it.
sentences.chinese: 上周末我看了一部很棒的电影，你应该看看。

sentences.english: The batteries in this flashlight are supposed to last for 20 hours, but they died after just two.
sentences.chinese: 这手电筒的电池应该能用20小时的，但才两小时就没电了。

sentences.english: That sounds like a great idea!
sentences.chinese: 听起来是个好主意！

sentences.english: The sound of rain on the roof helps me fall asleep.
sentences.chinese: 雨水打在屋顶的声音能帮我入睡。

sentences.english: I woke up to a strange scratching sound, and after searching everywhere, I realized it was just a tree branch against the window.
sentences.chinese: 我被一阵奇怪的抓挠声吵醒，找了一圈才发现只是树枝在蹭窗户。

sentences.english: I also like chocolate ice cream.
sentences.chinese: 我也喜欢巧克力冰淇淋。

sentences.english: She plays the guitar well and also writes her own songs.
sentences.chinese: 她吉他弹得很好，还自己写歌。

sentences.english: We went to the zoo and also had a picnic in the park, which turned out to be the perfect day.
sentences.chinese: 我们去了动物园，还在公园里野餐了，结果那天过得特别完美。

sentences.english: I'm really busy right now.
sentences.chinese: 我现在非常忙。

sentences.english: The café is always busy on weekends, so we should go early.
sentences.chinese: 那家咖啡厅周末总是很热闹，我们最好早点去。

sentences.english: I had such a busy week that I haven't had time to relax, so I'm planning to do absolutely nothing tomorrow.
sentences.chinese: 这周太忙了我都没时间放松，所以明天我打算什么也不做。

sentences.english: I need a glass of water.
sentences.chinese: 我需要一杯水。

sentences.english: You don't need to bring anything to the party, just yourself.
sentences.chinese: 你来派对不用带东西，人过来就好。

sentences.english: When I'm feeling stressed out, what I really need is a quiet corner and a good book.
sentences.chinese: 当我感到压力大时，我真正需要的是一个安静的角落和一本好书。

sentences.english: Go play with your sister.
sentences.chinese: 去和你妹妹玩。

sentences.english: Can you play that song again? It's my favorite.
sentences.chinese: 你能再放一遍那首歌吗？那是我的最爱。

sentences.english: I used to play hide and seek with my cousins at my grandparents' farm, and we'd hide in the barn until it got dark.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候和表兄妹在爷爷奶奶的农场玩捉迷藏，我们会躲在谷仓里直到天黑。

sentences.english: I received a letter from my grandma.
sentences.chinese: 我收到了一封奶奶的来信。

sentences.english: He wrote a thank-you letter to his teacher on the last day of school.
sentences.chinese: 他在学期最后一天给老师写了一封感谢信。

sentences.english: I found a love letter my grandpa wrote to my grandma back in the 1950s, and it was the most romantic thing I've ever read.
sentences.chinese: 我发现了一封爷爷在1950年代写给奶奶的情书，那是我读过最浪漫的东西。

sentences.english: I live near the school.
sentences.chinese: 我住在学校附近。

sentences.english: We're looking for a new place to live, closer to downtown.
sentences.chinese: 我们在找离市中心更近的新住处。

sentences.english: I want to live in a place where I can walk to the beach and drink fresh coconut water every morning.
sentences.chinese: 我想住在一个可以走着去海边，每天早上喝新鲜椰子水的地方。

sentences.english: We took a boat to the island.
sentences.chinese: 我们坐船去了那个岛。

sentences.english: There's a small island in the middle of the lake where birds nest.
sentences.chinese: 湖中央有一个鸟儿筑巢的小岛。

sentences.english: We spent our summer vacation on a quiet little island with no cars, no noise, and the clearest water I've ever seen.
sentences.chinese: 我们在一个安静的小岛上度的暑假，那里没有车、没有噪音，还有我见过最清澈的海水。

sentences.english: I will always love you.
sentences.chinese: 我会永远爱你。

sentences.english: My grandma always gives me a hug when I walk through the door.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶总是在我进门时给我一个拥抱。

sentences.english: Even when life gets tough, my best friend always knows how to make me laugh and see the bright side.
sentences.chinese: 哪怕生活不如意，我最好的朋友也总有办法逗我笑，看到事情好的一面。

sentences.english: Let's explore the cave!
sentences.chinese: 我们去探索那个洞穴吧！

sentences.english: The tour guide showed us ancient paintings on the cave walls.
sentences.chinese: 导游给我们看了洞穴墙上的古老壁画。

sentences.english: When I was a kid, we found a small cave in the woods and turned it into our secret clubhouse.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候在树林里发现了一个小洞穴，把它变成了我们的秘密基地。

sentences.english: It's hot, let's go swimming!
sentences.chinese: 好热，我们去游泳吧！

sentences.english: We used to go swimming in the river after school every day in June.
sentences.chinese: 我们以前六月每天放学后都去河里游泳。

sentences.english: The water is a little cold this morning, but if we wait until the sun comes out, I'll definitely go swimming.
sentences.chinese: 今天早上水有点凉，但等太阳出来后，我肯定要去游泳。

sentences.english: I want to win the game.
sentences.chinese: 我想赢下比赛。

sentences.english: Our team worked so hard and finally won the championship.
sentences.chinese: 我们队非常努力，终于赢得了冠军。

sentences.english: You don't always have to win; sometimes the best lessons come from losing and trying again.
sentences.chinese: 你不一定非赢不可，有时候最好的教训来自于失败和重新尝试。
